🛬 Your first hour after landing — just do this

The diagram above shows the Airport Railroad (AREX) transfer route — with heavy bags take the 6705A direct bus (no transfer), travelling light take the AREX. The steps below follow the recommended 6705A.
  1. Activate your eSIM — turn on the eSIM you installed before the flight, right after landing. (No SIM-counter queue needed.)
  2. Get a WOWPASS — issue the card at a self-service kiosk on the arrivals floor (~5 min). Just bring your passport.
  3. Board bus 6705A — Incheon Airport T1/T2 ↔ Jamsil limousine (18,000 KRW (≈$13), no transfer — stops at a few stations en route before Jamsil). Pay at the airport 1F booth / self-service machine, or tap a WOWPASS / transit card on board. Last bus from the airport ~22:55 (T1 23:15) — for a late flight, take the AREX (Airport Railroad) + Line 9 or a taxi instead.
💳 WOWPASS, don't worry — 3 steps and you're done

Foreign-card 3DS checks fail often, so grabbing a prepaid WOWPASS in advance saves the stress. The flow is simple:

  1. Issue — reserve online on the official site and pick it up at an airport kiosk without queuing, or just issue it at a WOWPASS kiosk on the Incheon arrivals floor (or a subway station). About 5 minutes; bring your passport + the 6,000 KRW (≈$4) issuance fee (official registration fee, non-refundable).
  2. Top up — install the WOWPASS app and load it with a foreign card (VISA · MC · AMEX). (App top-up 4% fee · kiosk top-up free.)
  3. Done — one card now covers ticket payments, transit, and convenience stores.

WOWPASS official site · app download ↗

You can also reserve online (Reserve Card) on the official site — handy for skipping the airport kiosk line. Enter your passport's English name exactly (a single wrong letter can mean entry denial).

7N8D Full Pilgrimage Course

7N8D matches the 8.7-day average stay of international visitors who came to Korea for a K-pop show (2026 survey by the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism & Korea Tourism Organization, based on BTS's Seoul show). The show + pilgrimage + goods & pop-ups, plus palace & tradition (Gyeongbokgung · Bukchon), a music-show audience try and a free day. All real places.

Jamsil base reference

Jamsil base, 7 nights. Flow: Day 1 arrive & settle → Day 2 pilgrimage → Day 3 show → Day 4 goods & pop-ups → Day 5 palace & tradition → Day 6 music-show try → Day 7 free day → Day 8 departure. Rough budget: 7 nights' lodging approx. $399–854 (based on the 'Where to stay' rates below) · flights, tickets & meals not included.

Show Times
Three nights — Fri 7/10 19:00 (= 5:00 AM CDT) · Sat 7/11 18:00 (= 4:00 AM CDT) · Sun 7/12 17:00 KST (= 3:00 AM CDT, US Central). Main show approx. 2h 40m (+α with encore)

2026-06-11 20:00 KST (= 6:00 AM CDT, US Central)
Where to Book
NOL Ticket (world.nol.com) ↗
Price Range
Standing General 154,000 KRW (≈$110), Reserved General 154,000 KRW (≈$110)
Standing = floor, no assigned seat (entry by queue order) · Reserved = numbered seat. Seoul's seat layout isn't publicly confirmed — general definition.
Foreigner payment
  • Overseas cards often fail 3DS authentication → use a prepaid WOWPASS.
  • One WOWPASS = transit (subway · bus · taxi) + payment in one — issue once at the airport.
  • Enter your passport name in English exactly (one wrong letter risks entry denial).
WOWPASS issue & top-up details
3DS (3-D Secure): an extra identity check your card issuer runs before payment (SMS OTP / app auth).Issue WOWPASS at the airport on arrival and it covers both getting around and paying (see the 'first hour after landing' timeline above). WOWPASS (a NOL World partner) can be reserved online (Reserve Card) on the official site → skip the airport kiosk line, or issue it in person at 160+ unmanned kiosks (airport, subway, etc.; 6,000 KRW (≈$4) registration fee); top up in the WOWPASS app with an overseas card (VISA/MC/AMEX, etc. — 4% fee for app top-ups, free at kiosks). Bring your physical passport on the day. Confirm the exact pickup method on the ticketing site notice.If you only need a transit card, the T-money Korea Tour Card (4,000 KRW (≈$3) cash at convenience stores) is an alternative — but it has no payment-card function.
Safe resale
  • Use the official transfer system / escrow only. Avoid premium DM deals on social media.
  • Before paying, check the account & phone number on TheCheat.
  • Never share photos of your passport or ID.
Scam reporting & details
TheCheat is a Korean-only site — pair it with a translation app such as Papago or Google Lens. If you're a victim, report via the Korean Police ECRM (mostly Korean, English support unconfirmed; requires identity verification (mobile / I-PIN) — the victim files in person). Foreigners are a known scam target, so be especially careful with direct deals.

🎟 How to catch cancelled tickets — where & how

For this show, returned tickets aren't on a separate page — the same NOL booking page simply re-opens seats. Even when sold out, cancellations and unpaid orders drop those seats back into the seat-selection screen. Open the NOL link below and refresh the seat map while you wait.

Open the NOL booking page (world.nol.com) ↗

Step by step

  1. Prep first — log in to NOL and register your payment method (overseas card / WOWPASS) in advance. Released seats disappear within minutes, so checkout has to be fast.
  2. Wait during hot windows — keep the seat-selection screen open and refresh. Cancellations cluster at 0–2 AM the night after booking (unpaid release) and the day before & same-day, last minute.
  3. Grab it instantly — tap the seat and complete payment in one go. NOL holds a seat for only a few minutes, so any hesitation loses it.
  4. Check multiple dates — keeping the 7/10, 7/11 and 7/12 pages open at once raises your odds.

Cancellation deadline: 17:00 the day before the show (NOL / Interpark) — no cancel/refund after, so that window is when returns appear.

Other sellers' general patterns (not related to this show): Interpark 09:00–09:10 · Yes24 00:03–00:05 · Melon 00:12–00:20 tend to see returns circulate.

※ General patterns, not confirmed for this show — check the official seller (NOL) notice first. Macros, auto-booking tools and scalped resale violate the terms and can void your booking.

🧭 Local travel essentials
Getting around
Subway (Lines 1–9, Sinbundang Line, etc.) and city buses dominate the Capital Region. Integrated multi-modal transit system. Standard transit cards: T-money and Cashbee—accepted at nearly all transit and convenience stores.
Language
Korean is the main language. Major tourist sites, concert venues, and transit have English signage. Day-to-day English varies—moderate overall.
Last train
All three nights have room. The only catch: Line 9 westbound (Gaehwa) on Sat/Sun ends ~22:55 → board by 22:30. Full last-train & back-calc table → After last trains: Owl Bus, taxis, Kakao T (see ‘Late-night transit apps’ below).
See more
Payment
Cards and mobile payments (Samsung Pay, etc.) widely accepted. Street vendors and small transactions may need cash. QR codes (Kakao Pay, Naver Pay) are common.
Currency & exchange
Currency: Korean won (KRW, ₩). Card payments are standard, so exchange needs are minimal. ATMs and exchange bureaus available at airports and city centers.
Local apps
Kakao T (Taxis, driver services, and ride-hailing available) · Naver Map (Public transit routes & real-time directions) · Kakao Pay (QR codes, quick-pay)
Late-night transit
Kakao T (Night-taxi standard (90%+ market share, fastest matching). Foreign phone sign-up restricted.) · Uber (Taxi hailing—bring your overseas card & number. Made for travelers.) · TADA (Carnival vans—sign up with your overseas number & card.) · i.M (Book premium minivan taxis.) · K-RIDE (Traveler-only taxis (no KakaoTalk; Seoul, Incheon & metro).) · Owl Bus (Seoul Night Bus) (After last train: night buses—official Seoul routes (N15, N16, N26 & more).)  📶 eSIM ↗
How to book
Don't hail from the venue—walk 1–2 blocks out, you'll match faster. Go a station farther, demand drops.
Around the venue
Olympic Park Peace Gate 📍Monument to the '88 Olympics in sprawling park grounds. Popular for strolls and photos.
Lotte World Mall 📍Large complex mall with Olive Young, duty-free, K-fashion, observation deck. One-stop shopping before and after the concert.
